payload.core_mechanism_summary: Memoized recursion (lru_cache) over triple (posA, posB, min_char) decides win by simulating optimal play on DAG with monotonic character constraint.
payload.rationale: The code uses a recursive function with caching to compute a boolean DP. The state includes two vertex positions and a lower bound on next character. This is typical for DP on DAGs with memoization.
